page.title: Enchantment Reckonin'
page.heading: Enchantment reckonin'
page.reset_help: Clear yer setup an' settin's, an' see the first screen again (stashed setups stay)
page.language_confidence: The code's colour shows how sure the translation be, matey: green, aye sure; yellow, so-so; red, poor (an unchecked scribble, arr).
page.feedback_title_suggestion: What would you like to see?
page.feedback_ask_correction: What is wrong, and what should it say or do?
page.feedback_ask_bug: What happened, and what did you expect?
page.feedback_ack: I understand that my feedback, including my setup and anything I type in it (such as a rename), will be public on GitHub
page.feedback_no_account: No GitHub account? Use Copy report instead.
page.feedback_translation_note: Thank you for helping! Pick the language and make the change right in GitHub's editor: when you save, it's sent to us for review.
page.feedback_tier_3: This translation has been checked, but we'd still love to hear if something is off.
page.feedback_tier_2: This translation is fairly reliable, and a second pair of eyes would help.
page.feedback_tier_1: This one is still a draft, so your corrections would mean a lot.

bedrock.label: Bedrock
bedrock.help: Bedrock Edition: each enchantment costs only the levels it adds, Impalin' be cheaper, an' there be no Edged saber

wanted.intro: Find the cheapest anvil order to bind enchanted logbooks onto an item. Pick the item an' its enchantments, then follow the steps, matey.
wanted.example: Try an example: Mermaid legs on Peg-leg
wanted.graph_hint: {nodes} enchantments, {edges} conflicts. Hover or focus one to see its conflicts; click to choose it.
wanted.expand_groups_label: Unfurl all groups an' boxes in Enchantments
wanted.collapse_groups_label: Stow all groups an' boxes in Enchantments
wanted.legend_one: In a Pick one, choose one option, or none. Choosin' another replaces it.
wanted.legend_side: The sides canna go together: take from one side only. Each side shows its own rule.
wanted.legend_part: The parts never conflict: take from any of 'em, each by its own rule.
wanted.legend_any: In a Pick any, the options go together: choose as many as ye like.
wanted.legend_stray: Also conflicts with somethin' in another side or part (hover it to see what).
wanted.legend_badges: Badges that number the sides an' parts of a group.
wanted.cost_meter_help: Anvil levels for the best order with the books below
wanted.preset_best_help: The usual best enchantments for this item, at max level, without curses
wanted.preset_swap_help: The best set, with {name} in place of what it conflicts with

cost_help.one: About {levels} level to add this from a book, before any prior work
cost_help.other: About {levels} levels to add this from a book, before any prior work

wanted.short_help: Yer logbooks an' items in the Logbooks an' items section can't reach the level chosen here.

books.automatic_help: One logbook for each enchantment chosen in the Enchantments section
books.custom_help: List yer own logbooks an' items, with copies an' prior work

prior_work_cost.one: Its prior work adds {levels} level to each merge it's in.
prior_work_cost.other: Its prior work adds {levels} levels to each merge it's in.

books.prior_work_none: Never used on an anvil, so no extra cost.
books.edit_line: Change enchantments, or drag onto another entry to move it
books.coverage_label: Enchantments chosen in the Enchantments section, reached or not
books.cover_toggle: Show or hide the enchantments already reached
books.chip_drag_hint: Drag onto an entry to put it there
books.duplicate_help: Add a copy of this entry, to change it

copies_edit.one: Copies: {count}. Use − an' +, or scroll over it
copies_edit.other: Copies: {count}. Use − an' +, or scroll over it

books.type_placeholder: Type a logbook: prot 4, mending, x3
books.type_label: Add one logbook by typin' its enchantments, with commas between 'em; add x3 for three copies
books.reorder_help: Drag to reorder, or focus an' press the up an' down arrow keys
books.copies_help: How many identical copies of this ye have, e.g. a stack of the same logbook
books.prior_work_help: How many times this has already been used on an anvil. Each use makes later merges more expensive.
books.alert_auto_note: One logbook for each chosen enchantment; yer custom list be dropped.
books.unwanted_help: Not chosen in Enchantments. It'll still go on the item an' cost levels.

ranking.rank_by: The best order is picked by the four tiles below: the order with the lowest value in the first tile wins, and the next tiles break ties. Drag a tile, or use its ‹ › arrows, to change which counts most.
ranking.rank_help_label: How the best order is chosen

xp.label: XP
xp.help: Total XP points spent. Higher levels cost more XP each.

max_step.label: Max level
max_step.help: Most levels spent on one anvil wallop

prior_work.label: Prior work
prior_work.help: Prior work on the result: the lower it is, the cheaper later anvil use on it will be

ranking.show_motion_help: Off, nothin' on the page slides, fades or moves (glints have their own switch). It is kept in this browser; the page also follows yer device's reduced-motion setting.
ranking.glints_reduced: Off: yer device asks for reduced motion
ranking.glints_help: The slow purple sheen over enchanted items and chosen enchantments. It keeps runnin' when Show animations is off; turn it off here.
ranking.rules_reset_help: Level limit 39 and no conflicts, as in the game
ranking.allow_conflicts_help: For mods that let conflicting enchantments go together
ranking.mods_help: Adds a mod's enchantments to the lists. The numbers come from the mod's own files an' may differ in yer version.
ranking.level_limit_help: No anvil use may cost more levels than this
ranking.level_limit_label: Most levels allowed per anvil use
ranking.rename_help: Type a name to rename the item in the last step (+1 level). Leave it blank for no rename.
ranking.rename_label: New name for the finished item
ranking.your_level_help: Yer XP level now, to see what ye have left after each step
ranking.set_needed_help: Set yer level to exactly what the steps not yet ticked need
ranking.use_level_help: Follow yer level through the steps: the level before an' after each one

results.slow_search: {count} entries: this may take a while, matey.
results.too_many_different: Too many different entries. Repeated logbooks be fine, but at most 20 different ones.
results.no_valid_order: No valid order: these can't be combined.
results.no_valid_order_within: No valid order within the {limit}-level limit.
results.limit_lowered_hint: Every order has a step above yer limit.
results.too_expensive_hint: Every order has a step of 40 levels or more, which the game refuses (“Ye need more gold!”). Logbooks with less prior work, or fewer enchantments per logbook, may help.
results.break_step: Without a limit the best order has {steps} steps, and step {number} costs {levels} levels: over yer limit of {limit}.
results.break_beyond: Even without a limit, step {number} costs {levels} levels. The game stops at {game}.
results.extra_help: These came along on yer logbooks or items. They be included in the cost.
results.round_help: These steps don't need each other's results, so do 'em in any order.
results.step_done_help: Tick off steps as ye do 'em. Kept in this browser.
results.anvil_wear_help: Each anvil use has a 12% chance to damage the anvil. A new anvil breaks on its third damage.
results.compact_help: Show only the slots, with the details when ye hover

step_instruction.one: Put {left} in the left slot an' {right} in the right slot. Take the result: it costs {levels} level.
step_instruction.other: Put {left} in the left slot an' {right} in the right slot. Take the result: it costs {levels} levels.

results.step_rename_note: Type “{name}” in the name box first.

checkpoint.one: Gain {count} level first: ye need level {level}
checkpoint.other: Gain {count} levels first: ye need level {level}

results.copy_checklist_help: Copy the steps as a checklist, with a checkbox for each
results.copy_steps_help: Copy the steps as text, e.g. to paste in a chat
results.print_help: Print the steps, or save 'em as a PDF
results.share_help: Copy the steps or the link, or print 'em
results.copy_link_help: Copy a link to this setup, with the steps ye have ticked

text_totals.one: {levels} level in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step
text_totals.other: {levels} levels in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step

results.worker_failed: The calculator failed to load. Check the browser console for details.
results.metadata_failed: Couldn't load the enchantment data. Serve this folder over HTTP instead of openin' the file directly.

descriptions.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders, bees, silverfish an' endermites
descriptions.binding_curse: Can't be taken off once worn
descriptions.blast_protection: Less damage an' knockback from explosions
descriptions.breach: Hits ignore some o' the target's armor
descriptions.channeling: Thrown in a thunderstorm, it calls lightnin' down on the target
descriptions.density: Smash attacks do more damage the farther ye fall
descriptions.fire_protection: Less fire damage, an' burnin' stops sooner
descriptions.fortune: More drops from ores an' crops
descriptions.frost_walker: Turns water to ice as ye walk over it
descriptions.infinity: Shootin' doesn't use up arrows (ye need one)
descriptions.loyalty: The trident comes back after it's thrown
descriptions.luck_of_the_sea: Better chance o' treasure when fishin'
descriptions.mending: Experience ye pick up repairs the item
descriptions.projectile_protection: Less damage from arrows an' other projectiles
descriptions.riptide: Throwin' it in water or rain launches ye with it
descriptions.silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves, like ores an' glass
descriptions.soul_speed: Walk faster on soul sand an' soul soil
descriptions.thorns: Hurts mobs an' players that hit ye
descriptions.wind_burst: Smash attacks bounce ye back up into the air
